response.justification: Bogdan has strong backend and distributed-systems expertise with real-time data handling (e.g., microservices at Dunnhumby) and event-driven architecture experience (GISCollective). However, his current role at re:cinq focuses on AI-agent infrastructure rather than production multi-agent AI systems in fintech. Lack of direct fintech or credit-risk experience is a significant gap, though his general AI-agent work (MCP, frameworks) shows some alignment. His leadership experience is limited to scaling teams to ~10-15 people, not the 30+ required.
strengths: Strong distributed-systems and real-time data expertise (Dunnhumby, GISCollective)
Proven ability to build scalable event-driven platforms (GISCollective, MCP tools)
Cross-language proficiency (TypeScript, D, C++, Java) with hands-on architecture work
concerns: Limited experience with multi-agent AI systems in production (current role is AI-agent infrastructure, not commercial deployments)
No fintech or credit-risk background (critical for this role)
Leadership experience scales teams to 10-15, not the 30+ required for this venture-backed scale-up
